simple.meaning: מִיכָיָה (Mîykâyâh) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Kings, Nehemiah, Jeremiah, beginning at 2 Kings 22:12. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִיכָיָה (H4320) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מִיכָיָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מִיכָיָה (Mîykâyâh) / H4320 is tracked through 2 Kings 22:12, Nehemiah 12:35, Nehemiah 12:41, Jeremiah 26:18. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: Micajah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H4320. Mikayah מִיכָיָה proper name, masculine 1. the canonical prophet, Micah , Jer 26:18 Kt (Qr מִיכָה , as Micah 1:1 ). 2 Neh 12:35 (called מִיכָא 11:17 , 22 ). 3 Neh 12:41 4 2Kin 22:12 (|| 2Chr 34:20 מִיכָה ).
definitions.rootNote: from 4310 and (the prefix derivative from) 3588 and 3050 ; who (is) like Jah?;
